tree.heading: Inspection.—
tree.text: A member, or an agent or attorney of the member, may inspect the records of the corporation for any proper purpose, at any reasonable time.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2270936:67m.July 23, 1947, ch. 298, § 14, 61 Stat. 408.
